q1.question: How does Wordmet help me learn vocabulary more effectively?
q1.answer: Wordmet connects new words directly to the real context you encountered. Using spaced repetition, it schedules timely reviews to help you transition from merely recognizing words to actively using them.

q2.question: Is Wordmet completely free?
q2.answer: Yes. Core features like word saving, flashcards, automated review scheduling, and basic exercises are free forever. You also get a 14-day free trial for AI-powered practice features.

q3.question: How is Wordmet different from other vocabulary apps?
q3.answer: Instead of requiring manual card creation or static word lists, Wordmet automatically converts your saved sentences into interactive practice exercises. It also prioritizes challenging words so you spend time where it matters most.

q4.question: Are my saved sentences shared publicly?
q4.answer: Not at all. Your saved sentences and vocabulary lists are 100% private and will never be shared publicly or added to a global database.

privacy.intro: This page explains how Wordmet handles your email address when you sign up for launch updates.
privacy.collectBody: Your email address, preferred page language at sign-up (Vietnamese or English), and sign-up timestamp. We use a single cookie to remember your language preference; no advertising or tracking cookies are used.
privacy.useBody: Exclusively to send you updates about Wordmet's launch. Wordmet will never sell or share your email address with third parties.
privacy.storeBody: Your data is stored securely in a Cloudflare D1 database under Wordmet's account. Cloudflare provides infrastructure support and processes data strictly on our behalf.
privacy.deleteBody: You can request data removal by emailing <link>{email}</link> from your registered address. We will remove your email from our list within 30 days and send confirmation.
privacy.changesBody: When full user account features are introduced, this policy will be updated and communicated to registered users before taking effect.
